mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user u WHERE u.deleted = 0) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user u WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.created_at >= #{userSince}) AS userNew7d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_item i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 'ON_SALE') AS itemOnSale, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_item i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 'PENDING') AS itemPending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_item i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 'REJECTED' AND IFNULL(i.audit_at, i.updated_at) >= #{rejectSince}) AS itemRejected7d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'DONE') AS orderDone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'DONE' AND o.finish_time >= CURDATE()) AS orderDoneToday, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM t_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'DONE') AS gmv, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(o.amount), 2), 0) FROM t_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'DONE') AS avgAmount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM t_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'DONE' AND o.finish_time >= #{periodStart}) AS periodGmv, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM t_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'DONE' AND o.finish_time >= #{prevStart} AND o.finish_time < #{periodStart}) AS prevGmv

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS amount FROM t_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'DONE' AND o.finish_time >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT IFNULL(c.name, '其他') AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, IFNULL(SUM(i.price), 0) AS amount FROM t_item i LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = i.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 'ON_SALE' GROUP BY i.category_id, c.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT o.school_id AS schoolId, IFNULL(s.name, '未归属校区') AS schoolName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_item i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 'ON_SALE' AND i.school_id = o.school_id) AS onSaleCount FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_school s ON s.id = o.school_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'DONE' GROUP BY o.school_id, s.name ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT CASE i.risk_level WHEN 'LOW' THEN '低风险（直发）' WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN '中风险（待审）' WHEN 'HIGH' THEN '高风险（驳回）' ELSE '未分级' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, IFNULL(SUM(i.price), 0) AS amount FROM t_item i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.risk_level
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_item WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_item WHERE deleted = 0 AND risk_level IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_item WHERE deleted = 0 AND view_count > 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.item_id) FROM t_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.item_id) FROM t_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'DONE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_item WHERE deleted = 0 AND risk_level = #{level}
